text:
mina: Hi all, I'm Mina (new PM) in Sydney (AEST). My calendar shows the product tour at 02:00 local which seems wrong. The invite says 16:00 UTC but I thought the official time was 17:00 UTC? Also Outlook removed the passcode and my phone won't show the meeting description. Where do recordings live and who handles redaction?

arun: welcome @mina! Official is 17:00 UTC this week (we slipped an hour for EMEA). Apologies for the confusion 62c. We had to reschedule and a second invite got sent; delete the older one that has "DRAFT" in the title.

mina: ahhh that explains it. my calendar had both and my device picked the wrong one. thanks.

remy: Re recordings: Google Drive -> New Hires/Session Recordings. We redact vendor PII before moving to the shared folder. If the recording is still in "Private Onboarding" folder, ping me and I'll add you.

kai: For mobile clients, Outlook sometimes strips lines that look like passwords. We try to put the passcode both in the event description and the location field. If you still don't see it, reply here and onboard-bot will echo the passcode.

onboard-bot: Zoom meeting updated: ID 333-222-111, passcode: 6019 (auto-posted)

arun: @mina I'll re-send a single invite bound to Australia/Sydney timezone so your phone renders correctly. Also tagging @remy for redaction note: slide 4 needs vendor blur.

remy: got it, I'll blur slide 4 after the session and then move the cleaned file to New Hires/Recordings and update perms.

mina: thanks 60a. one more Q: where do we keep notes from the session? I couldn't find the doc linked on the calendar.

arun: session notes live as a Google Doc linked in the event under "Agenda & Notes". If it's missing, it's usually because the draft invite didn't have the doc linked. I'll attach it and repost.

kai: small tip if you're into commands: `gcalcli agenda "Onboarding" --tsv | grep "Product Tour"` to inspect invites locally. Not necessary but handy.

mina: good to know :) Appreciate the quick help!

arun: I'll post a final recap here after the session with the recording link and confirmation that redaction is done.
